newsitem.title: FINLAND: FISKARS Q1 PROFIT SEEN HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: FISKARS Q1 PROFIT SEEN HIGHER.

text.p: A Reuter survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 50 million markka median
forecast for durable consumer goods manufacturer Fiskars Oy's
first quarter profit after financial items, before
extraordinaries.
Profit after financial items EPS
(FIM million) (markka)
Median 50 4.6
Mean 53 5.2
Lowest 43 3.8
Highest 77 7.4
The results are due on May 7.
In January-April 1996, Fiskars posted a 41 million markka
profit before extraordinaries.
The median of forecasts for Fiskars' full-year 1997 earnings
was a 266 million markka profit before extraordinary items (mean
262 million) and the range was 251-296 million markka. Fiskars'
1996 profit before extraordinaries was 218 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were: AG Private Bankers,
Carnegie Securities, FIM Securities, Interbank, Merita and
Opstock.
